data.name: Caedmon
data.gender_notes: Caedmon is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Anglo-Saxon tradition, Caedmon was a poet who was inspired by a dream to join a monastery and create religious poetry. The name Caedmon carries the meaning “Friend of the monastery” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Caedmon usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of the monastery and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Dedication to spiritual growth and creativity.
data.etymology: Caedmon belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend of the monastery.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Caedmon total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: קאדמון
in_hebrew.meaning: קדמון הוא שם שפירושו נאמן או משרת שירה נוצרי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: קדמון הוא שם שמקורו באנגלית העתיקה ומשמעותו 'משרת שירה' או 'נאמן'. השם קדמון מורכב משתי מילים: 'caed' שפירושו 'שיר' ו-'mon' שפירושו 'נזיר' או 'משרת'. השם נמצא בשימוש בעיקר בתרבות הנוצרית והוא קשור לשירתו של המשורר הנוצרי קדמון, שחי במאה ה-7 באנגליה.

in_greek.name: Κάεδμον
in_greek.meaning: Ο Κάεδμον είναι όνομα που σημαίνει υπηρέτης του τραγουδιού ή πιστός
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Κάεδμον προέρχεται από την παλιά αγγλική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'υπηρέτης του τραγουδιού' ή 'πιστός'. Το όνομα αυτό αποτελείται από δύο λέξεις: 'caed' που σημαίνει 'τραγούδι' και 'mon' που σημαίνει 'μοναχός' ή 'υπηρέτης'. Το όνομα Κάεδμον χρησιμοποιείται κυρίως στην χριστιανική κουλτούρα και συνδέεται με τον χριστιανικό ποιητή Κάεδμον, που έζησε τον 7ο αιώνα στην Αγγλία.

in_latin.name: Caedmon
in_latin.meaning: Caedmon est nomen quod significat servus cantici vel fidelis
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Caedmon oritur ex lingua anglica antiqua et significat 'servus cantici' vel 'fidelis'. Nomen hoc componitur ex duabus vocibus: 'caed' quod significat 'cantus' et 'mon' quod significat 'servus' vel 'monachus'. Nomen Caedmon in usu est praecipue in cultura christiana et coniungitur cum poeta christiano Caedmon, qui vixit saeculo VII in Anglia.

in_english.name: Caedmon
in_english.meaning: Caedmon means servant of song or faithful one in Christian tradition
in_english.long_meaning: The name Caedmon originates from Old English, meaning 'servant of song' or 'faithful one'. It is derived from two words: 'caed' meaning 'song' and 'mon' meaning 'servant' or 'monk'. Caedmon is a name primarily used in Christian culture, associated with the 7th-century Christian poet Caedmon, who was known for his hymns and biblical paraphrases. The name symbolizes a devoted servant of God, reflecting spiritual dedication and a gift for music or poetry.

data.cultural_impact: Caedmon is best known for being the first English poet whose name is recorded in history. He is celebrated as a significant figure in Anglo-Saxon literature, and the story of his inspiration and transformation into a poet has been a source of inspiration for writers and scholars for centuries.
data.spiritual_significance: The story of Caedmon illustrates the transformative power of God's inspiration and the potential for personal growth and creative expression in the context of religious devotion. The idea that a simple farmer could be called to create sacred poetry showcases how even the most ordinary person could be elevated to a divine purpose. This themes resonates strongly with Christians, emphasizing the idea that everyone has the capacity for great things with the guidance and inspiration of God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Caedmon, an Anglo-Saxon poet, is believed to have been called by angels to create music and poetry in praise of God. His name, derived from 'caeddan' meaning 'to sing' or 'to make music', symbolizes the divine inspiration and creative power bestowed upon him.
